title: Compact board on phones
summary: On phones the board rows shrink from 44px to 36px with 20px flap type and tighter gaps, and the intro collapses to one line ("Najděte 8 nejčastějších odpovědí stovky AI. Pět životů."), so the whole board, the input and the strikes fit on the first screen together, even with a clue line open. Tablet and desktop are unchanged.
tradeoffs: Smallest change and no new UI, but with the keyboard open the board still scrolls out of view on short phones; the phone intro no longer mentions the 100 Czech personas.
